correctness.rationale: Dahmer–Kersting Section 2 Lemma 1 supplies the exact expectation of each lineage frequency count. Independence of the exponential holding times and the ranked merger topology yields the finite sum without unaccounted cross-level covariance; stage variances are 4/[k²(k−1)²]. Pascal's difference identity proves strict signed differences with positive term k=j+2. The fixed-k lineage expectation has a uniform summable envelope, so dominated convergence proves the continuum profile including both boundary regimes. Independent exact-rational merger enumeration for n=2..8 gives 140 checks; numerical limits are explicitly not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full descendant-frequency spectrum and genealogical root age are canonical population-genetic quantities. Their covariance profile gives a natural complete all-order classification (not a hand-picked statistic) and a sharp, frequency-dependent macroscopic transition between limiting levels 4 and 2. These statements expose a structural property invisible in fixed-frequency means 2/r and aggregate age covariance; the result has independent mathematical value without claiming downstream reconstruction or a joint limit theorem.
